scope: This checks the elementary inverse-square fibre and polynomial root-count reduction used by DilationNondeg. It does not construct the specialized Semaev polynomials or prove their nonvanishing; those curve-specific algebraic obligations and the collector/runtime assembly remain open.
statement: For any tuple-indexed bad-dilation predicate over a finite field, if every tuple has a nonzero univariate polynomial of degree at most D that vanishes at u^(-2) for every bad nonzero dilation u, then every tuple has at most 2D bad dilations.
